scope: Independent validity/model review only; no duplicate MCA, build, benchmark, worker call or source edit.

isolated_repeat_dependencies.classification: Artificial rank output to checkpoint-base input recurrence
isolated_repeat_dependencies.real_consumer_definition_that_breaks_rec: 0x18e10 ldr w6,[x6,w20,uxtw#2], before each group region; query w19 is also regenerated.

isolated_repeat_dependencies.classification: Artificial rank output to query-offset input recurrence
isolated_repeat_dependencies.real_consumer_definition_that_breaks_rec: 0x18ffc add w19,w17,w16 and 0x19018 msub w19,w20,w5,w19 regenerate offset; 0x19084 reloads checkpoint w20.

other_register_behavior: Leading ldr q2 defines a fresh width vector each iteration; ushll/ushll2 define fresh v3/v4 temporaries. These do not create a comparable loop-carried vector live-in.
v0 zero and v1 one-mask vectors are read-only live-ins assumed ready by this extraction.
Load base/index registers and initial scalar query/checkpoint data are assumed ready, rather than obtained through checkpoint search and query generation.

primary_model_source.observed_definition: Both neoverse-v2 and neoverse-v3 ProcessorModel definitions select NeoverseV2Model. ProcessorFeatures and Tune definitions remain distinct.
primary_model_source.terminology: Shared scheduling model, not a complete CPU alias.

interpretation: 38 single-iteration total cycles include simulated dispatch/retirement start and drain and the model 6-cycle load; not measured c9g latency.
17021/1000=17.021 cycles per repeated region includes the artificial scalar recurrence explicitly present in the critical-sequence report; not independent-query throughput.
Block RThroughput4.8 is the scheduling model reciprocal-throughput estimate ignoring dependency chains; not latency, measured throughput or a guaranteed sustained rate.
Identical V2/V3 output is expected from the shared NeoverseV2Model and supplies no independent evidence about actual V3 relative scheduling uplift.
Instruction latencies and V2Unit resource use are assumptions of this model. They do not measure cache tier, page translation, branch prediction, LLC or DRAM service.
The complete query additionally pays query generation, checkpoint selection/base load, group-base rank addition, tomb lookup and output/checksum work.
review_disposition: Parent initial_limits correctly identify the extraction recurrence and synthetic nature of totals. No interpretation error found when those limits are preserved.
